rules.problem: Page places uncomplicated pyelonephritis in the 'not needing urgent attention' box, i.e. flank pain + leucocytes/nitrites WITHOUT vomiting, sepsis, diabetes, male, pregnant or post menopause. The rule has no (no ...) exclusions, so it is a strict superset of the complicated rule and fires in every complicated case too. Same diagnosis concept as the complicated rule, so the practical effect is a duplicate probable diagnosis, but the structure is not faithful.

rules.problem: The page reaches 'Mechanical back pain likely' only after 'No' to BOTH question lists. The rule omits '> 50 years' from the first list and '< 40 years', 'pain better with exercise' and 'does not get better with rest' from the second, so it fires for e.g. a 60-year-old or a patient whose pain improves with exercise, whom the page sends to x-ray or to 'Inflammatory back pain likely'. Also, the page's 'Inflammatory back pain likely' (Yes/Unsure to the second list) has no probable diagnosis rule at all, and the x-ray branch (Yes to the first list) is not represented.

rules.rule: Urgent: back pain with red box features
rules.problem: Urgent is justified by the 'Give urgent attention' heading and the and/or structure follows the box. But 'Recent injury and x-ray unavailable or abnormal' is reduced to bare Traumatic injury, so any injury, however old and whatever the x-ray shows, makes the patient Urgent.

summary: The mechanical back pain rule is looser than the page: it ignores age > 50, age < 40, 'pain better with exercise' and 'does not get better with rest', and the page's 'Inflammatory back pain likely' outcome has no diagnosis rule at all, so patients the page routes to x-ray or to inflammatory back pain are labelled mechanical. The urgent priority and check_for reduce 'Recent injury and x-ray unavailable or abnormal' to any Traumatic injury, and the uncomplicated pyelonephritis rule lacks the exclusions that make it the non-urgent case. Every red-box criterion, dipstick finding, sepsis vital and 'X likely' diagnosis otherwise traces faithfully to the page; the remaining imprecisions are dropped qualifiers (morning stiffness > 30 min, sleep disturbed by pain, oral steroids, anus lesions).
